findings.location: Proof 3.1, final inference: an untouched component is called a copy of D and excluded by minimality.
findings.evidence: [F1] determines the abstract surface type and boundary homotopy classes of a normal-vector realization. Step 2.1 excludes only components whose normal vector is proportional to d. A disk component in the resolution of n d need not have vector proportional to d, so the proof has not shown that minimality excludes it. The argument needs per-component coordinate rigidity or a different connectedness/minimality argument. This gap blocks the connected-pair conclusion used downstream.
